legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.summary: This policy explains what information HandyHub collects through this website and while providing home services, why we use it, who can see it, how long we keep it and the choices you have.
legal.privacy.who.heading: Who we are
legal.privacy.collect.heading: Information we collect
legal.privacy.collect.intro: We collect the information you give us and the records created while we work on your project:
legal.privacy.collect.request: Your estimate request: the services you choose, your answers to the questions about each service, your project description, your preferred date and times, and how you would like to receive your estimate.
legal.privacy.collect.property: Your property: the address, unit and property type, so that we can check the service area and do the work.
legal.privacy.collect.contact: Your contact details: your name, email address and phone number, and your preferred contact method (email, phone call or text).
legal.privacy.collect.choices: Your choices: whether you agreed to receive texts and whether you gave marketing permission. Each is recorded separately, with the time and the version of the wording you saw.
legal.privacy.collect.photos: Photos you add to a request. Photos are optional, up to {maxRequestPhotos} per request.
legal.privacy.collect.project: Records of your project: messages between you and HandyHub, estimates and your approvals, appointments, job photos and invoices.
legal.privacy.collect.payments: Payment records: the method, amount, date and a transaction reference. We do not receive or store card numbers.
legal.privacy.collect.access: Property access details you choose to give us, such as a door code. They are kept in a protected field.
legal.privacy.collect.signin: Sign-in records: one-time codes are sent to your verified email or phone, and a cookie keeps you signed in for a limited time. Creating an account is optional.
legal.privacy.collect.technical: Technical records: our servers keep security and reliability logs. Passwords, codes, card data and property access details are never written to these logs.
legal.privacy.collect.draft: A request you have not sent yet is saved only in your own browser, for up to {requestDraftDays} days, so that you can finish it later. You can remove it at any time with Clear Draft.
legal.privacy.collect.noTracking: This website does not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking.
legal.privacy.use.heading: How we use your information
legal.privacy.use.review: To review your request, check whether your property is in our service area and prepare your estimate.
legal.privacy.use.contact: To contact you about your request and project through the channels you allowed.
legal.privacy.use.work: To schedule visits, do the work, review its quality, invoice it and record payments.
legal.privacy.use.identity: To confirm your identity before showing private project information.
legal.privacy.use.records: To keep the records we need for accounting, safety, complaints and disputes.
legal.privacy.use.protect: To protect this website and our customers from misuse, for example by spotting spam requests.
legal.privacy.use.marketing: We use your information for marketing only if you gave separate marketing permission. Sending a request, agreeing to texts or giving us your phone number is not marketing permission.
legal.privacy.access.heading: Who can see your information
legal.privacy.access.staff: Authorized HandyHub staff see the information their role needs for your project. Our server checks every access, and important actions are recorded in an audit log.
legal.privacy.access.providers: We use these service providers to run HandyHub, each only for the purpose listed:
legal.privacy.access.render: Render hosts this website, our apps and our database.
legal.privacy.access.r2: Cloudflare R2 keeps photos and documents, such as estimates, invoices and receipts, in private storage.
legal.privacy.access.bird: Bird sends and receives our text messages and provides our business phone number.
legal.privacy.access.resend: Resend sends and receives our email.
legal.privacy.access.square: Square processes card payments you make through a Square payment link or with Square Tap to Pay. These payments happen outside our software; we record only the method, amount, date and transaction reference.
legal.privacy.access.signin: HandyHub staff sign in through HandyHub’s own login; no outside sign-in service is used.
legal.privacy.sms.heading: Text messages (SMS)
legal.privacy.sms.optIn: We text you only if you agreed to receive texts by checking the SMS box on the request form. Having your phone number is never permission to text you.
legal.privacy.sms.bird: We give your number to Bird, our text message provider, only so that it can deliver our texts and your replies.
legal.privacy.sms.stop: Reply STOP to any of our texts to stop them, or START to receive them again. Your choice is recorded.
legal.privacy.photos.heading: Photos
legal.privacy.photos.use: Photos you upload and photos taken during the work are kept in private storage. We use them to prepare estimates, plan and document the work, review its quality and keep a record of what was done.
legal.privacy.photos.access: Only authorized staff can see them, and you can see the photos shared with you. Photos open only through short-lived links after access is checked.
legal.privacy.photos.publish: We never publish a photo of your property, for example on our website, without your separate permission for that photo. Sharing a photo with you is not permission to publish it.
legal.privacy.photos.avoid: Please do not upload photos of payment cards, IDs, passwords or private documents.
legal.privacy.retention.heading: How long we keep information
legal.privacy.retention.intro: We keep each kind of record for a set period. When the period ends, the owner reviews the record for deletion; nothing is deleted automatically. A record connected to an open complaint, dispute, claim or legal hold is kept until that is resolved.
legal.privacy.retention.requests: Requests that never became a job: 2 years after the request is closed.
legal.privacy.retention.estimates: Estimates that were not accepted: 2 years after they expire or are closed.
legal.privacy.retention.profiles: Customer and property details: while you are an active customer, then 7 years after your last completed service.
legal.privacy.retention.accepted: Accepted estimates, work authorizations, contracts and change orders: 10 years after the job is closed out.
legal.privacy.retention.financial: Invoices, payments, receipts and refunds: 7 years after the related tax return is filed or the tax is paid, whichever is later.
legal.privacy.retention.operational: Job photos, project messages, checklists and arrival and finish times: 7 years after the job is closed out. Photos or messages that support an approval or contract are kept as long as that record.
legal.privacy.retention.safety: Safety acknowledgments and incident records: 10 years after they are closed.
legal.privacy.retention.accessCodes: Property access details: removed when they are no longer needed for authorized access.
legal.privacy.retention.sessions: Sign-in sessions and access links: they expire on their own, according to their security settings.
legal.privacy.retention.longer: The owner may keep a record longer, and longer legal, tax or contract requirements take priority over these periods.
legal.privacy.retention.pending: These periods are waiting for confirmation by a CPA and an attorney.
legal.privacy.choices.heading: Your choices and requests
legal.privacy.choices.texts: Texts: reply STOP to stop our texts at any time.
legal.privacy.choices.marketing: Marketing: you can withdraw marketing permission at any time. It never affects messages about your project.
legal.privacy.choices.requests: Your information: you can ask for a copy of your information, a correction or deletion. The owner reviews every request after confirming your identity, and tells you what will be deleted, what must be kept and why.
legal.privacy.choices.account: Your account: closing your login account is separate from the business records we must keep, such as invoices, payments and accepted estimates.
legal.privacy.contact.heading: Contact us
legal.privacy.contact.intro: For questions about this policy or to make a request about your information:
legal.privacy.changes.heading: Changes to this policy
legal.privacy.changes.text: Each version of this policy has its own number and date. The version you saw is recorded with your request. A changed policy gets a new version, and records keep the version they were made under.

legal.sms.optIn.how: You agree to receive texts by checking the SMS box on the estimate request form. The box is not checked in advance, and it is separate from accepting any terms and from marketing permission.
legal.sms.optIn.optional: Texts are optional: you can get an estimate by email or phone call instead. Sending a request or giving us your phone number is not agreement to texts.

legal.smsDisclosure.frequency: Message frequency varies with your request and project.

legal.smsVerificationDisclosure.disclosu: Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for assistance. Consent is not required to purchase services.

legal.sms.messages.automaticIntro: Automatic texts, each sent once for its event:
legal.sms.messages.receipt: A receipt for your request, with your reference and next steps.
legal.sms.messages.access: Secure links or instructions to view your project.

legal.sms.messages.visitOptions: Estimate visit options, and the confirmation of the visit you choose.
legal.sms.messages.notAFit: A notice when HandyHub cannot take on your request.
legal.sms.messages.estimateReady: A notice that your estimate is ready.
legal.sms.messages.approvalReceipt: A receipt when you approve an estimate.
legal.sms.messages.appointment: The confirmation of your work appointment, and a notice if it changes.

legal.sms.messages.remindersIntro: Reminders that HandyHub staff review and send:
legal.sms.messages.reminderEstimate: Up to two reminders about an estimate you have not answered.
legal.sms.messages.reminderQuestion: Up to two reminders about a question you have not answered.

legal.terms.title: Website Terms
legal.terms.summary: These terms describe how requests, estimates, appointments and payments work with HandyHub.
legal.terms.who.heading: Who we are
legal.terms.requests.heading: Requests and accounts
legal.terms.requests.guest: You can request an estimate as a guest; creating an account is optional. Accounts sign in with a one-time code sent to your verified email or phone, with no password.
legal.terms.requests.notAJob: A request is not a job, an appointment or a price. Staff review every request, and checking the service area does not confirm a price or an appointment.
legal.terms.requests.project: Your request creates a private project page. Private information is shown only after you verify your email or phone.
legal.terms.estimates.heading: Estimates
legal.terms.estimates.free: Estimates are free, online or at your property, and every project is priced individually.
legal.terms.estimates.validity: An estimate is valid for {estimateValidityDays} days from when it is sent to you.
legal.terms.estimates.approval: Work is scheduled only after you approve the exact estimate version. Your approval records that version, its options and its terms, which you see in full before you approve.
legal.terms.appointments.heading: Appointments
legal.terms.appointments.text: Appointments are confirmed separately. A preferred date in your request is a preference, not a booking.
legal.terms.scope.heading: Changes to the work
legal.terms.scope.text: Work beyond the approved scope, and any price change, needs your approval of a change order first.
legal.terms.payment.heading: Deposits and payment
legal.terms.payment.deposit: When the approved total is over {depositThreshold}, a deposit of {depositPercent}% of that total is due before the work is scheduled. The deposit is credited to your final invoice.
legal.terms.payment.invoice: The invoice is issued after the work passes the owner’s quality review, and payment is due when you receive it.
legal.terms.payment.methods: Accepted payment methods: credit or debit cards (Square), cash, check, Zelle, Cash App and Chime.
legal.terms.payment.recorded: HandyHub staff record each payment once it is verified; a check counts once it has cleared.
legal.terms.cancellation.heading: Rescheduling and cancellation
legal.terms.cancellation.early: Cancelling {cancellationNoticeHours} hours or more before the visit, before work starts: your full deposit is refunded and there is no charge.
legal.terms.cancellation.late: Cancelling less than {cancellationNoticeHours} hours before the visit, including when no one can let us in and you then cancel: {lateCancellation} is kept from your deposit and the rest is refunded; without a deposit, the {lateCancellation} is invoiced. Materials already bought do not add to it.
legal.terms.cancellation.started: Cancelling after work has started: you pay for the work done and the materials.
legal.terms.cancellation.byHandyHub: If HandyHub cancels or moves a visit, you choose a free reschedule or a full refund.
legal.terms.cancellation.pending: The wording of these rules is waiting for attorney review.
legal.terms.warranty.heading: Workmanship warranty
legal.terms.warranty.text: HandyHub gives a 90-day workmanship warranty, counted from the reviewed completion date.
legal.terms.warranty.pending: The wording of the warranty and any exclusions are waiting for attorney review.
legal.terms.messages.heading: Messages
legal.terms.messages.text: Some messages are sent automatically, such as receipts, codes, appointment confirmations and invoice notices. Reminders and other messages are reviewed and sent by HandyHub staff. Texts follow the SMS Terms.
legal.terms.privacy.heading: Privacy
legal.terms.privacy.text: Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information.
legal.terms.notCovered.heading: Topics not covered yet
legal.terms.notCovered.text: These draft terms do not yet include clauses on topics the owner has not decided, such as governing law, dispute resolution or limitation of liability. Whether any are needed is waiting for attorney review.
legal.terms.contact.heading: Contact us
legal.terms.changes.heading: Changes to these terms
legal.terms.changes.text: Each version of these terms has its own number and date. An approved estimate keeps the terms recorded with your approval.
legal.estimateTerms.title: Estimate Terms
legal.estimateTerms.summary: These terms go with your HandyHub estimate. They explain how long it is valid, how it is approved and how the deposit, payment and the work itself are handled.
legal.estimateTerms.testBanner: TEST — wording pending owner approval for real customer use
legal.estimateTerms.notInEffect: These terms are a draft and are not in effect yet. An estimate cannot be approved under them.
legal.estimateTerms.validity.heading: How long the estimate is valid
legal.estimateTerms.validity.text: The estimate is valid for {estimateValidityDays} days from when it is sent to you. After that it can no longer be approved, and you can ask for an updated estimate.
legal.estimateTerms.price.heading: Price
legal.estimateTerms.price.individual: Every project is priced individually, and the estimate shows the price of each line and the total.
legal.estimateTerms.price.noTaxLine: The estimate and the invoice show no separate tax line.
legal.estimateTerms.price.sameForEveryMe: Every payment method costs the same: nothing extra is added for paying by card.
legal.estimateTerms.deposit.heading: Deposit
legal.estimateTerms.deposit.scheduling: Confirmed scheduling of the work waits until the deposit is paid and verified, or until the owner waives it for your job.
legal.estimateTerms.deposit.noDate: Payment does not guarantee a particular date.
legal.estimateTerms.payment.heading: Payment
legal.estimateTerms.scope.heading: What the work includes
legal.estimateTerms.scope.approvedVersio: The work is what the approved version of the estimate describes, with the options you select when you approve it.
legal.estimateTerms.scope.exclusions: Anything the estimate lists as excluded is not part of the work.
legal.estimateTerms.appointments.heading: Appointments
legal.estimateTerms.appointments.separat: Approving the estimate does not book an appointment. Appointments are confirmed separately.
legal.estimateTerms.appointments.request: Requests to reschedule or cancel are confirmed by HandyHub staff.
legal.estimateTerms.safety.heading: Safety
legal.estimateTerms.safety.pause: If a safety concern comes up, the work pauses until it has been reviewed.
legal.estimateTerms.completion.heading: Finishing the work
legal.estimateTerms.completion.walkthrou: When the work is finished, you are asked to walk through it and say whether everything looks good or you have a concern. Silence or absence is never taken as acceptance.
legal.estimateTerms.completion.review: The owner then checks the quality of the work before it is marked complete.
legal.estimateTerms.reopen.heading: Closed requests
legal.estimateTerms.reopen.text: If a request is closed because HandyHub did not hear back from you, your reply in the {reopenDays} days after it closed reopens it for staff to look at again. A reopened request does not bring back an expired estimate or appointment.
legal.estimateTerms.photos.heading: Photos
legal.estimateTerms.photos.text: Photos of the work areas are taken before and after the work, and selected photos are shared with you on your project page. Photos are used for marketing only with your separate permission.
legal.estimateTerms.record.heading: Your electronic approval
legal.estimateTerms.record.how: You approve an estimate online by ticking “I have read and accept the estimate terms”, typing your full name and pressing Approve Estimate. Not answering, or a question you sent, never approves anything.
legal.estimateTerms.record.what: HandyHub keeps a record of each approval: the estimate version, the options you selected, the total and any deposit, the payment term, these terms with their version and a fingerprint of their exact wording, the name you typed, the verified email or phone you used and the time.
legal.estimateTerms.business.heading: Business name
legal.estimateTerms.business.name: Estimates and invoices are issued under the name Handyhub LLC.
